opportunity: At each sweep all cells count one material marker stroke. A fresh guarded-change offer precedes the stroke and its selector is restored. Until the root arms it uses its own change for the trigger. Completed incoming notices freeze the receiving heat contact after that sweep's offer.
network: Visit all external edges in deterministic disjoint matchings, both directions. A sender offers its shared rail only after its private acknowledgement. Return the consulted load before updating the receiver. Acknowledge after the whole sweep, with the root's first change posted at its end.
fixed_time: Read probe energy at the deadline whether or not it saw a notice. Retain notice status separately.
prehistory: A separate bank broadcasts a fair sharp bit starting one root eccentricity before reset. At reset its local latch selects a complete swap of the parked cold and warm dimers. Follow by H unconditioned local heat contacts and read all probes. Compare independent fair bits and a cut intercell exchange.
earlier_release: Run the same stochastic root trigger and active thermal contacts starting one eccentricity before the comparison clock reset. The reset sets the comparison origin only and applies no intervention to this bank.
pair_selection: Exclude the trigger owner. Report the lowest root-distance sum pair and the maximally separated disjoint-cone pair, using all pairs when none are disjoint. Break distance ties by root-distance sum and then lexicographic cell index.
analysis: Exact original-denominator joint hit and energy tables, all-pairs counts of disjoint program pasts, monopole-subtracted between-trigger energy power and independent count-level controls. Earlier arming and precision are follow-up tests of the already known thermal response.
contrast_selection: Follow-up local difference test on pairs of nonroot radial edges whose two unions of postreset program pasts are disjoint. Orient each edge outward. Choose the least sum of inner root distances and then lexicographic cell indices before counting. Compare time-zero arming, arming one eccentricity earlier, and a single common bit.
